outcome_state_at_freeze: No A-E or T0-T5 experiment has executed; no outcome may be inferred from source or fixture availability.

permitted_before_seal: independent label creation without candidate outputs
final_test_access.release_rule: Only sealed harness evaluation after checkpoint/configuration/patch lock; append-only records cannot feed selection.

permitted_scope_decisions.allowed_pre_outcome_change: Capability/licensing blocker found before a run may narrow its claim only in a versioned revision naming blocker and affected claims; lock, denominators, and unrun history persist.

planned_natural_final_test_minimum.rationale: Precision/heterogeneity floor, not an available-count claim.

population_and_statistics.interval: 95% source-family/time-group cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples; seed summaries separate.
population_and_statistics.coverage_rule: All eligible examples remain denominator: measured, abstained, unsupported, unavailable, timeout, invalid distinct.

common_budget.exhaustion: partial_or_unrun; retain attempts/costs and narrow only affected claims

teachers.source_gold: unavailable_pending_AF-005; compiler/adaptor targets are never semantic gold
teachers.proof_feedback: unavailable_pending_AF-003 checker and AF-012 feedback manifest
teachers.learned_advice: unavailable_pending_AF-011 checkpoint and AF-013 promotion receipt

checker_catalog.source_fidelity: independent candidate-blind facet adjudication, pending AF-005
checker_catalog.proof: native checker receipt where supported; solver-local results distinct, pending AF-003

conditions.inputs: Frozen natural/minimal-pair sources and declared vocabulary; direct model to target formalization.
conditions.teacher_availability: Direct-model route unavailable pending AF-003; independent source labels unavailable pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Same pinned target formal checker and independent candidate-blind facet adjudication.
conditions.budget: Common envelope; identical per-item time and model-call accounting.
conditions.control_comparison: A vs B on identical eligible tasks; unavailable is not zero.
conditions.claim: Direct model baseline under matched checker.

conditions.inputs: Frozen sources, deterministic bounded compiler, declared vocabulary, explicit abstention.
conditions.teacher_availability: Compiler/vocabulary identity unavailable pending AF-003; source labels pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned elaborator/compiler and independent facet adjudication.
conditions.budget: Common envelope; three replays and complete processing cost.
conditions.control_comparison: B vs A and C on identical tasks/checker/budget.

conditions.inputs: Frozen sources and typed source-grounded multiview representation; no cross-view proof transfer.
conditions.teacher_availability: Compiler/view targets unavailable pending AF-003; independent labels pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned compiler/elaborator, independent facets, native proof checker where supported.
conditions.control_comparison: C vs B isolates multiview representation without transfer.

conditions.inputs: C inputs plus checked property bridges and compatible cross-source premise assembly.
conditions.teacher_availability: Bridge/premise identities unavailable pending AF-003/AF-015; labels pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned bridge obligations, premise compatibility/nonvacuity, and native proof checker where supported.
conditions.budget: Common envelope including bridge validation and failed reconstruction cost.
conditions.control_comparison: D vs C isolates checked bridges and premise assembly.

conditions.inputs: D inputs plus bounded learned view/premise advice from frozen checkpoint; unchanged checker.
conditions.teacher_availability: Checkpoint/advice unavailable pending AF-011/AF-013; other teachers pending AF-003/AF-005.
conditions.checker: Same D checker stack; advice cannot replace checking.
conditions.budget: Common envelope plus checkpoint/advice/model-service cost; one service slot after reservation.
conditions.control_comparison: E vs D isolates learned advice with checker fixed.

conditions.inputs: Frozen sources, deterministic codec, and view adapters.
conditions.teacher_availability: Compiler/view identity unavailable pending AF-003; independent gold pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned compiler/profile and independent facet adjudication.
conditions.control_comparison: T2 vs T0 is primary shared-learner test.

conditions.inputs: T0 plus adaptive learner with sample memory; seen and unseen partitions reported separately.
conditions.teacher_availability: Compiler/view targets unavailable pending AF-003; independent gold pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned compiler/profile and independent facet adjudication.
conditions.budget: Three fixed seeds/common envelope; record memory state and lookup cost.
conditions.control_comparison: T1 vs T2 is memorization diagnostic, not generalization.

conditions.inputs: T1 learner with shared parameters only; update/evaluation memory disabled.
conditions.teacher_availability: Compiler/view targets unavailable pending AF-003; independent gold pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned compiler/profile and independent facet adjudication.
conditions.budget: Three fixed seeds/common envelope; checkpoint/config/parameter-change receipts required.
conditions.control_comparison: T2 vs T0 isolates shared learning; T2 vs T1 separates memory.
conditions.claim: Shared learner generalizes to unseen groups.

conditions.inputs: Frozen T2 checkpoint plus isolated proof-feedback heads and protected primary fingerprint.
conditions.teacher_availability: Proof-feedback/checker unavailable pending AF-003/AF-012; source gold pending AF-005.
conditions.checker: Pinned verifier, calibration/abstention, protected-parameter invariant check, independent facets.
conditions.budget: Three seeds/common envelope plus proof-feedback/checker cost.
conditions.control_comparison: T3 vs T2 isolates trusted proof heads.

conditions.inputs: Frozen T3 checkpoint plus admitted source-free stable guidance consumed by pinned compiler/realizer.
conditions.teacher_availability: Guidance export/consumer unavailable pending AF-013; upstream teachers pending AF-003/AF-005/AF-012.
conditions.checker: Paired canary, active-consumer load receipt, independent facets, native proof checker, rollback identity.
conditions.budget: Three seeds/common envelope plus promotion/canary/rollback/consumer costs.
conditions.control_comparison: T4 vs T3 with same profile and frozen source families.

conditions.inputs: Sealed T4 configuration (or explicitly unavailable T4 baseline) plus development-discovered bounded compiler/decompiler patch.
conditions.teacher_availability: Patch task/introspection and starting arm unavailable pending AF-014; final test forbidden for patch selection.
conditions.checker: Independent regressions, paired canary, pinned validator, activation/rollback, then locked final test.
conditions.budget: One bounded isolated-worktree patch attempt per defect plus common evaluation envelope; retain rejects/review cost.
conditions.control_comparison: T5 vs declared sealed T4 starting arm; no bundled numerical update.

completion_policy.full_empirical_completion: Explicit A-E/T0-T5 statuses and admissible evidence for each retained empirical claim; deletion/narrowing cannot satisfy it.
completion_policy.narrowed_route: Methods/protocol only, empirical gain/coverage/deployment claims removed; author decision required.
